_comment: Copy to umbilical.json to change which board pins are wired to the tool connector. A pin is still refused if anything in the Klipper config already uses it. Each entry is a plain name ("PB1") or an object with type 'logic' (3.3 V GPIO: any control, inputs and servos too) or 'mosfet' (a switched power output: on/off, level and fans only) and an optional label. The types below are EXAMPLES - set them to match your wiring.
